imappasswd.description: IMAP account password. Empty string means use saved password file or prompt.

imapport.description: Custom IMAP port. Empty string uses default.

imapinbox.description: Name of the IMAP inbox folder

spaminbox.description: Name of the IMAP spam folder

spam_action.description: Action to take on spam: flag, delete, or none

maxsize.description: Maximum message size in bytes to scan. 0 means no limit.

partialrun.description: Stop after scanning this many unseen emails. 0 means all.

use_spamc.description: Use spamc client instead of standalone SpamAssassin

dry_run.description: Do not actually make any changes

lockfilename.description: Override lock file name. Empty uses default.

passwdfilename.description: Path to file containing IMAP password

teachonly.description: Only learn from folders, do not search for spam

learnspambox.description: Name of folder to learn spam from

learnhambox.description: Name of folder to learn ham from

no_report.description: Don't include SpamAssassin report in spam folder

learnunflagfed.description: Only learn if message is unflagged

ignorelockfile.description: Don't stop if lock file is present

exitcodes.description: Use exit codes to report results

use_ssl.description: Use SSL to connect to IMAP server
